messages.content: My engagement dropped after I took a two week break, is that permanent damage?
Not permanent, honestly - algorithms tend to deprioritize inactive accounts temporarily, but it recovers with renewed consistent posting. Give it a few weeks of normal activity before panicking.
how many weeks roughly before i should worry

Fair question - I'd genuinely give it about a month of consistent posting before treating it as anything more than normal fluctuation. If it's still flat after that, then it's worth actually investigating content quality instead.
